column1: # ZAP rules: pluginid<TAB>action<TAB>comment. Passed to zap-baseline with -c and always applied by
# scripts/zap-gate.py. zap-api-scan deliberately gets NO -c: with -c it switches to the full Default
# Policy and runs out of memory (see the scan-dast target in the Makefile); the gate covers it.
# Medium/High alerts break the build (T15). Only IGNORE (with justification) suppresses one; none today.
# 10055 (CSP: Failure to Define Directive with No Fallback) is deliberately NOT listed: it broke the
# gate until form-action 'self' was added (VULN-030) and must keep breaking it if that ever regresses.
